big_case.notes: Follow-on FAAAA highway-safety preemption petition involving a major retail consignee (Walmart) and a produce shipper, vacating a published California appellate decision (114 Cal. App. 5th 873), but resolved via a routine unsigned GVR in light of Montgomery v. Caribe Transport II, LLC with zero cert-stage amicus briefs and no new national rule.
